plainTranslation: Attraction that flows naturally. You want each other in a way that feels effortless and warm, with little push-pull drama. Failure mode: effortless slides into complacency; easy chemistry still needs tending. Keep showing up for it - don't assume it runs itself.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
